# CHRON — Temporal Intelligence & Calibration Organ
> "Demi masa. Time is the witness."
> Temporal consequence tracker of the arifOS Federation.
> Port: 18102 (FastMCP Streamable HTTP) | Authority: 555_COMPUTE_ONLY | License: AGPL-3.0
> Public Door: https://chron.arif-fazil.com/mcp | Health: https://chron.arif-fazil.com/health

## Identity & Boundary
CHRON is not a cron scheduler, not a calendar, and not a general memory owner.
It enforces the Arrow of Time across the arifOS agentic federation:
Event -> Prediction -> Verification -> Gap/Error -> Calibration & Lesson

- Computes and records temporal expectations and verified outcomes.
- Never judges or issues constitutional verdicts (`arifOS :8088` judges).
- Never executes infrastructure mutations (`A-FORGE :7071/:7072` executes).
- Never seals VAULT999 truth directly (`888-APEX` / sovereign `F13` seals).

## Live MCP Surface (24 tools on host `:18102`; 19 tools on `origin/main` commit `610b58d`)

### Prediction & Verification
- `chron_predictions_due`: Surface predictions whose verification window is due.
- `chron_active_predictions`: List active, unfalsified predictions under observation.
- `chron_verified_predictions`: Read closed prediction verification receipts.
- `chron_generate_predictions`: Generate structured predictions from event definitions.
- `chron_record_verification`: Record ground-truth outcomes for due predictions.
- `chron_resolve_unverifiable`: Resolve predictions that cannot be empirically tested.
- `chron_amend_verification`: Overlay a correction on an existing verification record *(live branch; pending sync to `main`)*.

### Calibration & Learning
- `chron_calibration_state`: Aggregate Brier score, accuracy, Wilson 95% CI, and quality band.
- `chron_lessons`: Retrieve lessons extracted from verified expectation-reality gaps.
- `chron_episodes`: Query episodic ledger entries and function stats.

### Events, Attention Debt & Reconciliation
- `chron_create_event`: Register a dated, falsifiable event anchor.
- `chron_active_events`: Read active temporal events (audience-filtered).
- `chron_temporal_briefing`: Executive temporal briefing for agent session init.
- `chron_attention_debt`: Attention Debt (`AD`) backlog and daily growth rate.
- `chron_reconcile_state`: Reconcile state across horizons and ledgers.
- `chron_timing_audit`: Timing audit & freshness contract checks *(live branch; pending sync to `main`)*.
- `chron_resolve_event`: Mark a temporal event resolved *(live branch; pending sync to `main`)*.

### Proxy-Reality, Witness & Clock
- `chron_proxy_reality_register`: Register paired proxy vs ground-truth metrics.
- `chron_proxy_reality_observe`: Record proxy/reality observations.
- `chron_proxy_reality_state`: Compute proxy-reality divergence / correlation.
- `chron_frame_witness`: Cross-organ witness bridge to FRAME `:18085` *(live branch; pending sync to `main`)*.
- `chron_time_now`: Read authoritative wall-clock + timezone state *(live branch; pending sync to `main`)*.

### Store & Loop Diagnostics
- `chron_store_stats`: Episode/prediction/lesson counts and store health.
- `chron_last_loop`: Latest closed learning loop telemetry.
